articles.title: Toddlers learn by falling: Why DeFi's $20 billion TVL drop is just a market stress-test
articles.snippet: DeFi Technologies president Andrew Forson says the stablecoin layer is thriving, with more than $150 billion in U.S. Treasuries backing coins like USDT and USDC.

articles.title: Standard Chartered backs $4,000 ether as retail piles into the sub-$2,000 drop
articles.snippet: The bank says onchain metrics will pull the price back up, just as Amazon's stock price recovered after 2001. A retail dip-buying frenzy and a record futures short build say the bottom isn't in yet.

articles.title: US charges Google employee with insider trading bets on Polymarket
articles.snippet: The Justice Department and the CFTC allege that Google software engineer Michele Spagnuolo profited $1.2 million on Polymarket after accessing non-public information at work.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Majors Slide on Iran Escalations, ETF Outflows

articles.title: DeepSeek, Xiaomi Just Made Frontier AI 99% Cheaper. American Labs Went the Other Way
articles.snippet: Back-to-back price cuts from China's top AI labs have made their models a fraction of the cost of GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus.
